Messages.Author: David Hyatt
Messages.Body:
If a master card is played on a member of a specific clan, i.e. it
can only be played on a member of a specific clan, do its effects
persist even if the vampire changes clans with Clan Impersonation?

Some examples:
A Toreador with Aching Beauty becomes a Malkavian. The
Aching Beauty stays around, right? And its effects persist?

What about cards like Triole's Revenge? You play it on a
Ventrue. If they change clans, they still don't avoid the
effects of the Revenge, correct?

I just want to make sure that Clan Impersonation does not affect any
cards that might have been played on the vampire in question.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
d-h...@cs.uiuc.edu (David Hyatt) writes:





That's correct. The only thing Clan Impersonation affects (besides
which clan the vampire is) is whether or not the vampire is considered
a Camarilla vampire (based on the new clan's sect).

The section you included is 100% correct (and verified by Shawn).
An assamite who uses Clan Impersonation (CI) to become Gangrel will thus
be a Camarilla vampire, a Gangrel, and remain unable to commit diablerie
(by card text on all Assamites so far).

A Gangrel who uses CI to become Assamite will thus be a Non-Camarilla
vampire, an Assamite, and able to commit diablerie (as all vampires can,
barring card text).
